subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

On the flight, I was in the company of an extremely **__chivalrous__** man.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Degraded."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'chivalrous' **means courteous and gallant. (विनम्र और वीर)

 
 
• **Example**: *He was polite and **chivalrous**__ and never cursed in front of her.*
 
 
 
• **"Degraded"** means immoral and corrupt. (अनैतिक और भ्रष्ट)
 __
 
• **Example**: *He is in a **degraded**__ condition.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of** 'chivalrous' **is** 'degraded.'**
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: 'Noble'** means honorable and virtuous. (ईमानदार; साहसी और परोपकारी)
 
• **Option 3: 'Virtuous' **means morally upright and righteous. (सदाचारी, सद्‌गुणी, गुणवान)
 
• **Option 4: 'Courteous'** means polite and well-mannered. (शिष्‍ट, भद्र, विनम्र और प्रीतिकर)

41:Tc1b,

The correct answer is **"Disapproval."**
